tasks.short: Evaluate suitability for a dependency program

steps.what: Interview clients about their background, condition and program needs
Review records relevant to mental and physical condition
Confer with professional colleagues about the client's condition and program fit
Evaluate condition and determine suitability for the specific program
Write and verify the assessment in the existing client record

loop.purpose: Draft the counselor's assessment note from explicit dictation
loop.input: Counselor's dictated facts, assessment and rationale for the identified client
loop.output: Draft assessment note separating reported facts from judgement
loop.check: Counselor checks identity, attribution, condition, risk statements and suitability rationale against the dictation and evidence
loop.stop: One correction; uncertain content is entered manually and unsupported risk statements are removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The counselor's narrative varies beyond fixed case fields

tasks.design: Use a native record view in {OTHER}, the client care-record application, and a bounded note-drafting loop from the counselor's own dictation. Interviews, consultation and suitability judgement remain human; the existing assessment note is written and checked separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record navigation and narrative entry consume time around the assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Care-record dictation products demonstrate note drafting while leaving assessment and correction with the practitioner.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability depends on interacting needs, incomplete accounts and the program's actual capacity.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise risk and decide whether this program is appropriate for this person.
tasks.altitude: Assist the assessment record while retaining direct professional evaluation.

reach.learn: Preserve attribution and uncertainty in the shared evidence

evidence.claim: Attendi describes dictation into care-record reports and letters, including GGZ use; this does not establish local suitability-assessment savings.
The digest reports invented risk content in social-work AI notes, supporting explicit checks rather than unreviewed record use.

assumptions: The suitability note already informs program assessment and is split from the interview and decision. No new eligibility notice, referral or approval record is introduced.

The counselor produces client facts in s1, reviews record dates and identity in s2 and dictates the explicit assessment in s5. Dictation, capture and correction remain within the 15 retained note hours. Missing information is investigated manually.
The native view removes 2 of 20 navigation hours. No reduction is assigned to reading clinical meaning, consultation or suitability judgement.

Professional colleagues are within the provider in this case; outside-provider consultation would use act_external with a disclosure check. The author edits and saves in the same record, with no separate machine write-back or self-approval stage.
research_questions: Does note assistance reduce total work after dictation, corrections and risk-omission checks?

already_counted.description: Dictate, correct and verify the suitability note

incremental.description: Sample draft-note quality and test changed drafting behaviour

approvals.approved_version: Exact client facts and questions shared with the identified colleague; changed content or recipient requires reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=93, gross 7 less 2 upkeep gives 5 net. Conservative case: the record view is already efficient and complex needs require 18 note hours, with other 80 and 2 upkeep yielding zero. A usable record view retaining 19 review hours and checked drafting retaining 16 note hours plus other 60 and 2 upkeep gives 3 net. Consultation and clinical judgement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in case conferences and staff meetings

steps.what: Review the case material needed for the conference or staff meeting
Participate in case conferences or staff meetings and resolve care questions
Write assigned case actions in the existing care plan
Confirm the final assigned actions with responsible colleagues

tasks.design: Use a native case view and existing care-plan headings in {OTHER}, the care-record system. The counselor participates personally, then separately writes the actual assigned actions and confirms responsibility with colleagues.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case navigation and action-heading entry consume time around meeting participation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and existing case-plan sections can remove these small operations without recording the whole meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Care disagreements and unclear responsibilities require direct professional discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Contribute contextual judgement and ensure actions are understood.
tasks.altitude: Reduce case-record handling while retaining substantive collaboration.

reach.learn: Distinguish written actions from confirmed ownership

evidence.claim: Native case views and care-plan sections can reduce repeated navigation and structure without replacing meeting participation.

assumptions: The counselor already updates assigned case actions in a care plan read by the care team. No new meeting minutes, transcript or participation log is added; staff meetings without such actions have no s3 saving.
The counselor selects client and agenda in s1 and produces action, responsible colleague and timing fields in s2-s3, with capture counted. Unclear actions are clarified manually before entry.
The view removes 1.5 navigation hours; action headings remove 2.25 of 15 writing hours. Clinical action content and responsibility confirmation remain fully retained.
Ordinary author saves have no approval stage. Internal colleague conversations use write_internal, not act_external.
unknowns: Share of meetings generating case actions
research_questions: Do actual assigned actions involve the specified repeated heading and navigation work?

already_counted.description: Write actual case actions and confirm responsibility

incremental.description: Maintain the native case-action view as fields change

approvals.approved_version: Exact case information and proposed actions spoken to the current care colleagues; changed recipients or content require reconsideration
Exact final action, responsible colleague and timing confirmed; revisions invalidate the previous confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=96.25, gross 3.75 less 0.5 upkeep gives 3.25 net. Conservative case: current case access is already direct and templates remove only half an hour of action headings, offset by half an hour upkeep. Compatible case metadata removing one lookup hour and reusable headings removing 1.5 writing hours retain 97.5 hours and 0.5 upkeep gives 2 net. Discussion and action confirmation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate post-treatment activities with outside agencies

steps.what: Review the client's current plan and relevant agency contact details
Coordinate activities with courts, probation officers and community agencies
Update the existing client plan with the coordinated arrangements
Prepare the existing written agency confirmation with permitted information
Check disclosure scope and send the final agency confirmation

tasks.design: Use native case and contact views in {OTHER}, the care-record system, and existing confirmation structure in {DOCS}. The counselor coordinates personally, updates the internal plan and separately checks and sends the exact agency confirmation through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation and record and message structure consume coordination time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and templates can remove these operations without choosing disclosures or making agency commitments.
tasks.still_hard: Agency availability, changing needs and permissible disclosures require direct judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a workable arrangement while protecting the client's information.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated coordination paperwork while retaining agency relationships.

reach.learn: Confirm the exact arrangement and information-sharing scope

evidence.claim: Native case/contact views and confirmation templates can reduce repeated handling; no local time effect is measured.

assumptions: The client plan and written confirmation are already read by the care team and receiving agency. No extra referral packet, coordination log or monitoring report is introduced.

The counselor produces current plan, recipient identity and disclosure scope in s1 and actual arrangements in s2-s4, with capture and checking counted. Missing permissions or uncertain recipients stop disclosure and are resolved manually.
The view removes 1.5 navigation hours; plan headings remove 3 entry hours; confirmation structure removes 2 writing hours. These are different operations and cuts.
The author saves the internal plan without a self-gate. The live agency conversation and final message send are separate external actions; neither receives a saving.
research_questions: Do templates remove only repeated structure while preserving case-specific responsibilities and disclosure limitations?

already_counted.description: Write the actual arrangement and check the exact confirmation before sending

incremental.description: Refresh contact views and confirmation structure as agency requirements change

approvals.approved_version: Exact client facts and proposed arrangements disclosed to the identified agency professional; changed information or recipient requires reconsideration
Exact final confirmation, permitted disclosure scope and verified agency recipient; edits void the send decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=93.5, gross 6.5 less 1 upkeep gives 5.5 net. Conservative case: agency-specific requirements defeat confirmation reuse, current views are direct, and existing plan headings remove one hour offset by one upkeep hour. With usable contact metadata removing one lookup hour, plan headings removing two entry hours and confirmation structure removing one writing hour, 96 hours remain and one upkeep gives 3 net. Both external handoffs stay fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review current chemical dependency program rules and participant needs
Prepare the existing orientation materials for the current session
Conduct orientation sessions and explain program participation
Answer participant questions and check understanding
Enter attendance and unresolved orientation needs in the existing program record

tasks.design: Reuse approved session sections in {DOCS} and the existing orientation-entry form in {OTHER}, the program care-record system. Delivery and questions stay personal; the counselor separately enters actual attendance and unresolved needs after the session.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated material assembly and stable participation-record fields consume preparation and entry time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse those sections and fields without counselling participants automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Anxiety, comprehension and individual needs require responsive explanation.
tasks.human_edge: Check whether participants understand and feel able to ask questions.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated orientation administration while retaining direct explanation.

evidence.claim: Native material and participation-record templates can reduce repeated structure while retaining direct session delivery and actual capture.

assumptions: The program already uses an orientation participation record to arrange follow-up; no new attendance log or survey is added. If such a record is not kept today, s5 has no eligible entry baseline.

The counselor produces participant context in s1, observes attendance and understanding in s3-s4 and captures session, identity, attendance and unresolved needs in s5. Capture is counted; uncertain participation or understanding is clarified manually.
Approved material reuse removes 3 of 15 assembly hours. Stable session and participant fields remove 2 of 10 entry hours; actual attendance and needs stay manually entered.
No advance enrolment or invitation send is merged with post-session completion entry. Ordinary author saves remain retained without a self-approval gate.
research_questions: Does native reuse remove the specified assembly and entry actions without treating attendance as understanding?

already_counted.description: Capture actual attendance and unresolved orientation needs

incremental.description: Refresh reusable orientation materials as program rules change

approvals.approved_version: Exact session materials and explanation for the current program; changed rules or materials require reconsideration before delivery
Exact response to the current participant question and circumstances; new questions require a new judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 central B=100, R=95, gross 5 less 1 upkeep gives 4 net. Conservative case: participant-specific material changes prevent section reuse and the current record form leaves one entry hour removable, offset by one upkeep hour. Compatible material sections removing two assembly hours and native fields removing one entry hour retain 97 hours and one upkeep gives 2 net. Review, delivery and questions remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep counselling and suitability decisions personal while reducing repeated record and communication structure.
reach: Coordinate clear responsibilities across care colleagues and agencies
Maintain useful assessment and orientation records
skills_to_grow: Check drafted care notes for invented risk statements
Use native records without hiding actual capture work
Separate conversations, plan writes and final sends
role.ambitious_version: A counselor with clearer records and coordinated handoffs while retaining time for direct assessment and relationships.

job.title: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
